name: Major 3rd — two shapes
position: Left: strings 6→5. Right: strings 3→2 (across the G–B kink)
description: Normally the major 3rd is one string up and one fret back. Crossing from G to B it is one string up, same fret.

name: Minor 3rd — two shapes
description: Normally one string up and two frets back; across G–B, one string up and one fret back.

name: Perfect 4th — two shapes
description: Normally straight across: same fret, next string up. Across G–B, one fret higher.

name: Perfect 5th — two shapes
description: Normally one string up, two frets higher — the power-chord shape. Across G–B, three frets higher.
